name: output-shaper
description: When a Bash command prints a lot, Claude reads its first and last lines, the line and character counts, and the path of the whole output with a hint to Grep or Read it

threshold.title: Shape output over (characters)
threshold.description: A command's output longer than this reaches Claude as its first and last lines plus the path of the whole output. Output Claude Code already saved to a file (over 30000 characters by default) is always shaped. 2000 to 200000.

headLines.title: Lines from the start
headLines.description: How many of the first lines Claude reads. 0 to 500.

tailLines.title: Lines from the end
tailLines.description: How many of the last lines Claude reads. Errors and summaries are usually there. 1 to 1000.

saveDir.title: Folder for saved output
saveDir.description: Where the whole output is saved when Claude Code did not save it already, absolute or relative to the session's folder. Empty: .claude/output-shaper in the session's folder, kept out of git by a .gitignore of its own.

keepFailingTail.title: Keep the end of failing commands
keepFailingTail.description: On: Claude's Bash commands are wrapped so their whole output is also written to a file, and when a command fails and Claude Code cut its output, Claude reads the real last lines and the file's path. Off: commands run exactly as Claude wrote them.
